note: PATTTTERNS is a Notion-backed catalogue of real-world UI patterns: one page per example at /patterns/<n>-<slug> (e.g. /patterns/149-security-top-banner-youtube-studio, /patterns/293-collapsable-sidebar-menu-google-gmail, 200 OK checked 2026-10-07), 347 in the site's own sitemap.xml. The host in this corpus (patttterns.net) has no sitemap.json and 301s to patttterns.com; /patterns itself is client-rendered (0 links in its HTML), but the 22 /ui-patterns/<kind> and /ux-patterns/<kind> category pages do render their example links, so they are the urls_from sources (~261 example URLs). /ui-patterns and /ux-patterns are not matched themselves, so they stay out of the item list.
